name: hunkwise
description: A merge gate that turns a branch diff into per-hunk comprehension probes with answer keys computed from the diff itself.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('dist/ui', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('src/ui/workbench.html', 'dist/ui/workbench.html');"
